integrity: Closed-form rates follow from an explicit polynomial Poisson equation and stationary fourth moments, with an independent quadratic-variation calculation and an exact rational checker; no external independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Only positive parameters, stationary complete Poisson resetting of the Brownian forcing without resetting the position, one-dimensional linear confinement, and a covariance-matched Gaussian OU comparator; no finite-time dominance or noisy-observation inference.
title: Universal five-to-one excess of time-integrated quadratic fluctuations under resetting Brownian forcing
